source: It also matters when discussing “memory usage.” A model’s allocated global-memory footprint is a capacity measure. Cache occupancy is a transient hardware state. Register and shared-memory use are per-kernel resource requirements. They should not be added together casually as if they were one flat pool.
zh: 在讨论“内存使用”时它也很重要。模型分配的全局内存占用是一种容量度量。缓存占用是一种暂时的硬件状态。寄存器和共享内存的使用是每个内核的资源需求。它们不应该像一个平池一样随意地加在一起。
